lines: Ibrahim had seen the fire turn cool. He had seen water rise from a desert. And still, he asked his Lord for one more thing.
"My Lord, show me how You give life to the dead."
Allah said: have you not believed? He said: "Yes, but only that my heart may be satisfied."
So Allah told him to take four birds, cut them into pieces, and put a part of them on each hill. Then call them.
He called... and they came flying back to him, alive, in haste.
Faith does not mean you never ask. It means you ask the One who has the answer.
